messages.subject: Problem with iPlots….
messages.body_plain:
Greetings all....

The following is from an R-session on a Mac OSX Mountain Lion system, using R 3.0.2.
I'm attempting to create a matrix plot when this happens:

> library(rattle)
Rattle: A free graphical interface for data mining with R.
Version 2.6.26 r77 Copyright (c) 2006-2013 Togaware Pty Ltd.
Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.
> rattle()
Loading required package: JavaGD
Loading required package: iplots
Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'iplots', details:
  call: .jnew("org/rosuda/iplots/Framework")
  error: java.lang.InternalError: Can't start the AWT because Java was started on the first thread.  Make sure StartOnFirstThread is not specified in your application's Info.plist or on the command line
Error in print(ggcorplot(cor.matrix(na.omit(crs$dataset[crs$sample, ][c(4:5,  : 
  could not find function "ggcorplot"

One of the things I did do when doing the iplots install was to Sys.setenv("NOAWT=1") first, figuring it would get me around the issue, but no such luck.

Can anyone explain to me what I need to do to get around this problem?

Thanks in advance,
Joe

messages.subject: Re: Problem with iPlots….
messages.body_plain:
On Nov 16, 2013, at 9:59 AM, Joe Trubisz <trubisz at yahoo.com> wrote:

> Greetings all....
> 
> The following is from an R-session on a Mac OSX Mountain Lion system, using R 3.0.2.
> I'm attempting to create a matrix plot when this happens:
> 
>> library(rattle)
> Rattle: A free graphical interface for data mining with R.
> Version 2.6.26 r77 Copyright (c) 2006-2013 Togaware Pty Ltd.
> Type 'rattle()' to shake, rattle, and roll your data.
>> rattle()
> Loading required package: JavaGD
> Loading required package: iplots
> Error : .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'iplots', details:
>  call: .jnew("org/rosuda/iplots/Framework")
>  error: java.lang.InternalError: Can't start the AWT because Java was started on the first thread.  Make sure StartOnFirstThread is not specified in your application's Info.plist or on the command line
> Error in print(ggcorplot(cor.matrix(na.omit(crs$dataset[crs$sample, ][c(4:5,  : 
>  could not find function "ggcorplot"
> 
> One of the things I did do when doing the iplots install was to Sys.setenv("NOAWT=1") first, figuring it would get me around the issue, but no such luck.
> 
> Can anyone explain to me what I need to do to get around this problem?
> 

You can only use iplots from a multi-threaded Java session, e.g. in JGR. Recent OS X version no longer allow the use of AWT from single-threaded programs like R.

Cheers,
Simon
